title: Towards a Participatory and Social Justice-Oriented Measure of Human-Robot Trust
reasoning: The paper explicitly proposes a "social justice-oriented approach" for developing human-robot trust measures. It refers to frameworks like "Feminist HRI" and "Robots for Social Justice," and extensively discusses issues of "equity," "morals," "bias," and "ethical challenges" in HRI research and system design, making ethics and social justice a core component of its proposed methodology.
